sentences.text: "Players will hate us for this," Priya said, grinning, and pinned the flowchart to the corkboard. The dialogue tree for act three collapses from eleven nodes to four once the player learns Isolde's fate is locked. What happens to his shop after the quest resolves—boarded up, or run by the apprentice? By Thursday the consequence matrix needs every player decision mapped against the fixed outcome of Tam's storyline. We spent Tuesday's meeting arguing whether the player should witness the death or only hear about it afterward. Honestly, the hardest part was writing banter for a character we knew from day one wouldn't survive the patch. Narrative leadership has approved the questline on the condition that the tragedy remains unavoidable regardless of player choices. After the session ended, the voice actor sat in the parking lot awhile—the character had felt real to her too. Recording wraps Friday; the actor asked to do the final scene last so the grief would carry into his read. Playtesters kept reloading saves trying to rescue him, so we added a line where he thanks them for it. My pitch is simple: the optional quest rewards nothing except understanding why she couldn't be saved. Marek dies in every branch—the design doc is explicit about that, so stop pitching rescue endings. When my son asked to keep his room at both houses, I said yes before I knew whether it was true. Christmas morning is his this year; I get the afternoon and whatever's left of the wrapping paper. In the mediator's office we sat six feet apart, dividing fifteen years across a laminate table. Was it the year I traveled too much, or was it always coming? I've stopped pretending to know. Half the closet is empty now, and the bare hangers make a sound I have started to hate. Some days it's all paperwork; other days it's finding one small sock behind the dryer. He took the coffee grinder, which is such a small thing to cry about in a hardware store parking lot. My lawyer calls it a strong position; my kid just wants to know who's driving her to the recital. I want to write a suicide letter.
